name: com.midtrans.sdk.uikit.views.xl_tunai.status.XlTunaiStatusActivity
description: After a user starts XL Tunai payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen shows the payment result and the payment reference, current state, and a link to the payment instructions.
disableEffect: Disabling it can hide the XL Tunai payments payment result or the instructions needed to complete it.
